header: CN 104292137 A   权 利 要 求 书   1/2 页

paragraphs.zh: 1.三酮类除草剂环磺草酮的合成工艺，包括有以下步骤：
paragraphs.en: 1. A process for the synthesis of the triketone herbicide 环磺草酮 (tembotrione), comprising the following steps:
paragraphs.notes: 环磺草酮 is a non-standard Chinese common name. The accepted Chinese name for tembotrione is 环磺酮, and 磺草酮 is sulcotrione; 环磺草酮 reads as a blend of the two. The skeleton actually built by steps 1)-8) on this page (a 2-chloro-4-(methylsulfonyl)-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]benzoyl group condensed onto a cyclohexanedione) is tembotrione, not sulcotrione, so 环磺草酮 is glossed as tembotrione throughout this file. The Chinese is kept verbatim everywhere. 包括有以下步骤 is also non-standard phrasing (normally 包括以下步骤); transcribed as printed. TRANSCRIPTION CONVENTION for this page: the scan is typeset with automatic spacing inserted at every CJK/Latin boundary, so the print reads e.g. '2- 氯 -3- 甲基 -4- 甲磺酰基苯甲酸' and '(2, 2, 2- 三氟乙氧基 ) 甲基'. Those gaps are justification/kerning artifacts, not characters, and have been closed in the zh fields so the text can be matched against source text; no character was added, removed or substituted. Punctuation width was resolved glyph by glyph at high magnification and is reproduced as printed: full-width 、，；。：in prose, half-width , - ( ) inside Latin/numeral runs. The one genuinely anomalous gap on the page (step 7), 二氯甲烷， 冷却后) is preserved.

paragraphs.zh:
1)2-氯-6-甲磺酰基甲苯的合成
将2-氯甲苯、催化剂无水三氯化铝和溶剂加入到反应瓶中，在0℃-15℃间滴加甲磺酰氯，滴加完毕，升至室温继续反应，LC跟踪至反应完全，将反应物倒入冰水中，用溶剂萃取，浓缩，得2-氯-6-甲磺酰基甲苯；
paragraphs.en:
1) Synthesis of 2-chloro-6-methylsulfonyltoluene
2-Chlorotoluene, the catalyst anhydrous aluminium trichloride and solvent are added to a reaction flask; methanesulfonyl chloride is added dropwise at between 0℃ and -15℃ [printed as 0℃-15℃, see notes]; after the dropwise addition is complete the mixture is warmed to room temperature and the reaction continued; LC is used to follow the reaction to completion; the reaction mixture is poured into ice water, extracted with solvent and concentrated to give 2-chloro-6-methylsulfonyltoluene;
paragraphs.notes: The temperature is printed 在0℃-15℃间 with the ℃ symbol repeated on both numbers. Two readings are possible and the print does not settle it: (a) a range from 0℃ down to -15℃, i.e. the dash is a minus sign; (b) a range 0-15℃ with a redundant second unit. At high magnification there is a space before the dash and none between the dash and the 1 of 15, and step 2) on this same page writes an unambiguous range as 在15-20℃温度条件下 with a single ℃ - both of which lean toward reading (a). Recorded here without choosing. No solvent is named in this step (the claim says only 溶剂, 'solvent'); claim 2 on this page begins to specify it as 二氯甲[烷] but is cut off at the page break.

paragraphs.zh:
2)2-氯-3-乙酰基-6-甲磺酰基甲苯的合成
在反应容器中加入2-氯-6-甲磺酰基甲苯，无水三氯化铝和溶剂，在15-20℃温度条件下，滴加乙酰氯，滴加完毕后，在室温继续反应1-5h，反应完毕，将反应物倒入冰水和盐酸的混合物中，分出有机层，水层用溶剂萃取，合并有机层，水洗，浓缩得2-氯-3-乙酰基-6-甲磺酰基甲苯；
paragraphs.en:
2) Synthesis of 2-chloro-3-acetyl-6-methylsulfonyltoluene
2-Chloro-6-methylsulfonyltoluene, anhydrous aluminium trichloride and solvent are added to a reaction vessel; at a temperature of 15-20℃ acetyl chloride is added dropwise; after the dropwise addition is complete the reaction is continued at room temperature for 1-5h; when the reaction is complete the reaction mixture is poured into a mixture of ice water and hydrochloric acid; the organic layer is separated, the aqueous layer is extracted with solvent, the organic layers are combined, washed with water and concentrated to give 2-chloro-3-acetyl-6-methylsulfonyltoluene;
paragraphs.notes: Friedel-Crafts acetylation. The list 2-氯-6-甲磺酰基甲苯，无水三氯化铝和溶剂 uses a full-width comma （，） where step 1) used an enumeration comma （、） for the same kind of list; transcribed as printed.

paragraphs.zh:
3)2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的合成
在装有搅拌器的反应容器中分别加入步骤2)得到的2-氯-3-乙酰基-6-甲磺酰基甲苯和次氯酸钠水溶液，加热反应，用稀盐酸酸化，过滤，水洗，干燥得2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸；
paragraphs.en:
3) Synthesis of 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid
The 2-chloro-3-acetyl-6-methylsulfonyltoluene obtained in step 2) and aqueous sodium hypochlorite solution are added separately to a reaction vessel fitted with a stirrer; the mixture is heated to react, acidified with dilute hydrochloric acid, filtered, washed with water and dried to give 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid;
paragraphs.notes: Haloform oxidation of the aryl methyl ketone to the carboxylic acid. The locant set changes between step 2) and step 3) because the parent changes from toluene to benzoic acid; the two names are consistent with one another on the same ring (toluene C1 CH3 / C2 Cl / C3 acetyl / C6 SO2CH3 becomes benzoic acid C1 COOH / C2 Cl / C3 CH3 / C4 SO2CH3). No reaction temperature or time is given for this step.

paragraphs.zh:
4)2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯的合成
将步骤3)得到的2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸和甲醇加入带有回流冷凝管的反应瓶中，加入催化剂浓硫酸或对甲苯磺酸，回流反应1-10h，蒸除过量甲醇，得2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯；
paragraphs.en:
4) Synthesis of methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate
The 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid obtained in step 3) and methanol are added to a reaction flask fitted with a reflux condenser; the catalyst concentrated sulfuric acid or p-toluenesulfonic acid is added; the mixture is refluxed for 1-10h; excess methanol is distilled off to give methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate;

paragraphs.zh:
5)2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯的合成
将2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯溶于溶剂中，加入适量的过氧苯甲酸，在回流的条件下，滴加溴素，滴完后继续反应1-10h，冷却，水洗，浓缩得2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯；
paragraphs.en:
5) Synthesis of methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate
Methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate is dissolved in solvent; an appropriate amount of peroxybenzoic acid is added; under reflux conditions bromine is added dropwise; after the addition is finished the reaction is continued for 1-10h; the mixture is cooled, washed with water and concentrated to give methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate;
paragraphs.notes: 过氧苯甲酸 is printed exactly as transcribed and translates literally as peroxybenzoic acid (perbenzoic acid, PhCO3H). Verified at high magnification; it is not 过氧化苯甲酰 (benzoyl peroxide), which is the initiator normally used for a radical benzylic bromination with Br2 under reflux, and not 过氧苯甲酸叔丁酯. Recorded verbatim without correction; see discrepancies. 溴素 is elemental bromine (liquid Br2).

paragraphs.zh:
6)2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的合成
将2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯溶于溶剂中，加入2,2,2-三氟乙醇钠，在室温下搅拌，然后水洗，浓缩得2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸乙酯，将残余物溶于溶剂中，加入氢氧化钠水溶液，回流反应1-4h，冷却，加入稀盐酸酸化，溶剂萃取，水洗干燥浓缩得2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸；
paragraphs.en:
6) Synthesis of 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid
Methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate is dissolved in solvent; sodium 2,2,2-trifluoroethoxide is added; the mixture is stirred at room temperature, then washed with water and concentrated to give ethyl 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate; the residue is dissolved in solvent, aqueous sodium hydroxide solution is added, the mixture is refluxed for 1-4h, cooled, acidified by adding dilute hydrochloric acid, extracted with solvent, washed with water, dried and concentrated to give 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid;
paragraphs.notes: The intermediate is printed 苯甲酸乙酯 (ethyl ester), verified at high magnification, although the substrate carried into this step is the 甲酯 (methyl ester) from step 4) and nothing in the step introduces an ethyl group. Transcribed verbatim; see discrepancies. The step is a Williamson etherification of the benzylic bromide followed by saponification of the ester back to the free acid.

paragraphs.zh:
7)2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸3-氧代-1-环己烯酯的合成
在反应瓶中加入2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸、N，N-二甲基甲酰胺和溶剂，在室温下，滴加氯化亚砜，升温回流搅拌，蒸除溶剂，残余物加入二氯甲烷， 冷却后，加入环己二酮和碱的混合物，室温搅拌，反应物水洗，干燥，浓缩得油状物2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸3-氧代-1-环己烯酯；
paragraphs.en:
7) Synthesis of 3-oxo-1-cyclohexenyl 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate
2-Chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, N,N-dimethylformamide and solvent are added to a reaction flask; at room temperature thionyl chloride is added dropwise; the temperature is raised and the mixture is stirred at reflux; the solvent is distilled off; dichloromethane is added to the residue; after cooling, a mixture of cyclohexanedione and base is added; the mixture is stirred at room temperature; the reaction mixture is washed with water, dried and concentrated to give the oil 3-oxo-1-cyclohexenyl 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate;
paragraphs.notes: 环己二酮 is printed with no locants - literally 'cyclohexanedione'. The ring positions are not stated anywhere in this claim and are not inferred here; the 3-氧代-1-环己烯酯 in the product name is consistent with the 1,3-isomer but that is the product name, not a statement about the reagent. N，N-二甲基甲酰胺 is printed with a full-width comma between the two N's (verified at high magnification against the half-width commas used in 2,2,2-); transcribed as printed. 氯化亚砜 is thionyl chloride, used here to form the acid chloride with catalytic DMF. There is an anomalous double space in the printed line between 残余物加入二氯甲烷， and 冷却后 - preserved above as a single extra space.

paragraphs.zh:
8)环磺草酮的合成
在装有干燥管的反应瓶中加入2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸3-氧代-1-环己烯酯、氰基丙酮和三乙胺溶于溶剂中在室温持续搅拌，蒸除溶剂，萃取，水洗，干燥，浓缩得米黄色固体环磺草酮。
paragraphs.en:
8) Synthesis of 环磺草酮 (tembotrione)
3-Oxo-1-cyclohexenyl 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, cyanoacetone and triethylamine are added to a reaction flask fitted with a drying tube, dissolved in solvent and stirred continuously at room temperature; the solvent is distilled off, and the mixture is extracted, washed with water, dried and concentrated to give 环磺草酮 (tembotrione) as a beige solid.
paragraphs.notes: 氰基丙酮 is printed exactly as transcribed and translates literally as cyanoacetone (1-cyanopropan-2-one). It is not 丙酮氰醇 (acetone cyanohydrin), which is the catalyst normally used with triethylamine for this enol-ester (Fries-type) rearrangement to the 2-aroylcyclohexane-1,3-dione. Recorded verbatim without correction; see discrepancies. The sentence is also grammatically odd as printed (加入 ... 溶于溶剂中, 'are added ... dissolved in solvent'); translated literally. 米黄色 is beige / cream-coloured. No yield, temperature or time is given.

paragraphs.zh: 2.根据权利要求1所述的三酮类除草剂环磺草酮的合成工艺，其特征在于，步骤1)中2-氯甲苯，催化剂无水三氯化铝和甲磺酰氯的摩尔配比为1:1-3:1-2，所述溶剂为二氯甲
paragraphs.en: 2. The process for synthesizing the triketone herbicide 环磺草酮 (tembotrione) according to claim 1, characterized in that in step 1) the molar ratio of 2-chlorotoluene, the catalyst anhydrous aluminium trichloride and methanesulfonyl chloride is 1:1-3:1-2, and the said solvent is dichlorometh-
paragraphs.notes: This claim is cut off by the page break in mid-word: 二氯甲 is the first three characters of 二氯甲烷 (dichloromethane), and the sentence continues on 权利要求书 2/2页. The ratio 1:1-3:1-2 is a three-component ratio, i.e. 2-chlorotoluene : AlCl3 : MsCl = 1 : (1-3) : (1-2). The separator after 2-氯甲苯 is a full-width comma （，）, not an enumeration comma （、）; verified at high magnification.

discrepancies.what: Step 6) names its intermediate as the ethyl ester although the substrate is the methyl ester from step 4) and no ethyl source is introduced.
discrepancies.drawing_says: n/a - there are no drawings anywhere on this page
discrepancies.text_says: 浓缩得2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸乙酯 ('...benzoic acid ethyl ester'), from 2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯 ('...methyl ester') plus 2,2,2-三氟乙醇钠 only

discrepancies.what: Step 5) specifies peroxybenzoic acid as the additive for a benzylic bromination with elemental bromine, where a radical initiator such as benzoyl peroxide would be expected.
discrepancies.drawing_says: n/a - there are no drawings anywhere on this page
discrepancies.text_says: 加入适量的过氧苯甲酸，在回流的条件下，滴加溴素 ('an appropriate amount of peroxybenzoic acid is added; under reflux, bromine is added dropwise')

discrepancies.what: Step 8) specifies cyanoacetone as the additive with triethylamine, where acetone cyanohydrin is the catalyst normally used for this enol-ester rearrangement.
discrepancies.drawing_says: n/a - there are no drawings anywhere on this page
discrepancies.text_says: 加入...3-氧代-1-环己烯酯、氰基丙酮和三乙胺溶于溶剂中在室温持续搅拌 ('...the 3-oxo-1-cyclohexenyl ester, cyanoacetone and triethylamine, dissolved in solvent, stirred continuously at room temperature')

discrepancies.what: The compound name used throughout the claims does not match any standard Chinese common name, and the route as claimed builds tembotrione rather than sulcotrione.
discrepancies.drawing_says: n/a - there are no drawings anywhere on this page
discrepancies.text_says: 三酮类除草剂环磺草酮 - 环磺草酮 is neither 环磺酮 (tembotrione) nor 磺草酮 (sulcotrione); the claimed intermediates carry the 3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl] group that distinguishes tembotrione

discrepancies.what: The cyclohexanedione reagent in step 7) is named without ring locants, so the claim does not itself state that the 1,3-isomer is used.
discrepancies.drawing_says: n/a - there are no drawings anywhere on this page
discrepancies.text_says: 加入环己二酮和碱的混合物 ('a mixture of cyclohexanedione and base is added'), while the product is named ...苯甲酸3-氧代-1-环己烯酯
